tasks.notes: Fixed status bar overlay via Modifier.statusBarsPadding() so top navigation panel renders cleanly below the system status bar. tasks.title: Hamburger menu & tab manager drawer: slide-over sheet listing tabs with close, switch, and new tab
tasks.notes: Added TabsDrawerSheet.kt implementing Material 3 ModalDrawerSheet sliding drawer triggered by hamburger menu button or tabs badge. Provides complete list of open tabs with active indicator, close button (X) per tab to cancel/close tabs, + New Tab button, and quick access to Keep-Alive settings and Close Others.

tasks.title: Native EverBrowse Home Page: stress-free default search page with speed dial and quick search
tasks.notes: Added native HomePageView.kt as default landing page instead of auto-loading Google. Includes EverBrowse branding, prominent search/URL field, keep-alive status indicator, speed dial shortcuts (Google, Wikipedia, GitHub, DuckDuckGo, Reddit, Hacker News), and home button in top navigation bar.

tasks.title: Navigation back gesture & tab loading cancel: BackHandler history and stop-loading button
tasks.notes: Integrated Jetpack Compose BackHandler so back gesture / system back navigates to previous web pages in history instead of closing the app. If history is exhausted on a web page, returns to the native home page. If at home with multiple tabs, closes the active tab. Also added dedicated loading cancel button in the top navigation bar to abort in-flight tab loading.

tasks.title: Permissions & background usage auto-prompting: exact alarms, battery opt, and notifications on startup
tasks.notes: Configured auto-prompting of essential keep-alive permissions (exact alarms, battery optimization ignore, and post-notifications) on application launch. Tracks lifecycle onResume with dynamic recomposition so granted badges update immediately upon return from system settings. Provides direct 1-tap launchers for each system permission dialog.

tasks.title: Fix permissions: REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS in manifest, exact alarms real check, device admin isAdminActive check
tasks.notes: Declared REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS in AndroidManifest.xml so battery optimization intent dialog pops up cleanly. Removed USE_EXACT_ALARM from manifest so exact alarms no longer falsely auto-grant on Android 13+. Dynamically checked DevicePolicyManager.isAdminActive() so granted admin permission displays Granted accurately.

tasks.title: Remove swipe gesture on tabs drawer (gesturesEnabled=false) and remove duplicate right tabs button
tasks.notes: Disabled swipe-to-open gesture on ModalNavigationDrawer (gesturesEnabled = false) so vertical/horizontal page scrolling inside web sites is uninterrupted. Removed duplicate right-side tabs badge button; top bar now has a single hamburger menu trigger on the left and a quick + (New Tab) action.

tasks.title: Home screen shortcut icons: replace letter boxes with real vector iconography for web shortcuts
tasks.notes: Replaced generic letter boxes with distinct Material vector icons for all home screen shortcuts (Google, Wikipedia, GitHub, DuckDuckGo, Reddit, Hacker News) using EngineIcons with dedicated iconography.

tasks.title: Direct Downloads folder saving via MediaStore.Downloads with storage permission request flow
tasks.notes: Implemented direct saving of browser downloads to the standard system Downloads folder using MediaStore.Downloads on API 29+ and Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS on legacy Android. Added storage permission request launcher for WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE on Android <= 28, with cookie header preservation and toast status feedback.

tasks.title: Validate build config, dispatch release everbrowse-v3, verify release+APK via API, set build_complete true
tasks.notes: everbrowse-v3 verified live via GitHub Releases API: app-everbrowse-v3.apk (1.40 MB) + forgebuild-manifest.json. All v3 issues resolved.

tasks.title: Fix Google Colab & rich web app rendering: clean Chrome user-agent, third-party cookies, mixed content, and hardware acceleration
tasks.notes: Enabled hardware acceleration in AndroidManifest.xml. Configured WebSettings with mixedContentMode=MIXED_CONTENT_ALWAYS_ALLOW, domStorageEnabled=true, databaseEnabled=true, useWideViewPort=true, and loadWithOverviewMode=true. Enabled third-party cookies via CookieManager.setAcceptThirdPartyCookies so cross-origin Colab notebook iframes (*.googleusercontent.com) and auth frames load. Cleaned User-Agent by removing '; wv' and 'Version/4.0' so Google Colab treats EverBrowse as standard Chrome on Android. Added WebChromeClient.onPermissionRequest to grant notebook permissions.

tasks.title: Fix Refresh button: always-present reload action that unconditionally reloads active URL with fallback
tasks.notes: Separated Refresh button from Cancel Loading action. The Refresh button is now permanent in the top bar (never replaced or disabled by long-lived WebSockets or stuck progress). BrowserTab.reload() unconditionally reloads active tab URL with robust fallback to currentUrl if webView.url is uninitialized or blank, resetting progress and loading state.

tasks.title: Eliminate screen flash on search/go: continuous WebView attachment, keyboard focus clearance, and transparent background
tasks.notes: Eliminated jarring white screen flash and visual interruption on search/go. Set WebView background color to transparent, avoiding uninitialized white surface flashes. Kept active tab WebView continuously attached in Compose view tree (with HomePageView layered cleanly on top while at home) so the native rendering pipeline never tears down or remounts. Explicitly hid software keyboard and cleared focus on go/search submit.
